operation.description: Named refactoring primitive. The mesh only supports operations whose semantics are deterministic and reviewable; freeform LLM rewrites are NOT a refactor — route those through a code-edit task instead.

path.description: Sandbox file or directory the operation applies to. For rename/move the runner expands the scope to the symbol's full reach.

symbol.description: Target symbol for rename/inline/move/extract operations. Ignored for format/organize-imports.

new_name.description: Replacement identifier for rename-symbol. Must be a valid identifier for the target language; runner validates and rejects collisions.

selection.description: Line range for extract-function. Inclusive line numbers in the source file.

dry_run.description: When true (default), produces the diff without writing. Set false to apply.

diff.description: Unified diff of the proposed (or applied) change. Always present — chain to diff-review before applying.

applied.description: True when dry_run=false and the write completed. False on dry runs and on failed applies.

conflicts.description: Symbol collisions, syntax-error sites, or out-of-scope references that blocked a clean refactor.

summary: LSP-backed deterministic refactoring (rename, extract, move, organize-imports, format). Diff-first by default; apply step gated by human approval.
notes: This card is intentionally narrow. Anything that requires LLM judgment (e.g. 'clean up this module') is not a refactor and must not be routed here — the resulting diff would not be reviewable as a mechanical change.
